period_note: Balance sheet items are the period-end snapshot (reported) as of 2014-06-30. Income-statement items (Net Investment Income, Non Investment Income, Operating Expenses, Operating Profit, Net Profit After Taxation, EPS) and Net Operating Cash Flow Per Share are CUMULATIVE FROM 1 JANUARY 2014, as published in the annual report's own 'Evaluation of Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and Board' table (a BSEC-mandated corporate-governance disclosure) -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix, same convention as CITYBANK's embedded quarterly table. This interim table is SOLO/STANDALONE basis, matching SHAHJABANK's main Q4/annual series basis: verified because the same table's own 31-Dec-2014 column reproduces the already-validated quarterly/2014_Q4.json figures (e.g. Total Assets, Total Equity, Operating Profit, PAT) to rounding in every year checked -- confirming both that the table is Solo (not Consolidated) and that it needs no separate Q4 file (Q4 here is identical to the already-published annual figures, not new data). FY2014's OWN annual report predates this BSEC disclosure requirement (its Corporate Governance Compliance checklist item 1.5(ix) is answered with only a checkbox in FY2012-2014, and does not exist at all in FY2011); this table first appears with real data starting in the FY2015 annual report. FY2014's Q1/Q2/Q3 figures are therefore sourced from the FY2015 report's '01 Jan 14 to ...' comparative column -- the only place this data exists. Cross-validated against FY2014's own quarterly/2014_Q4.json (independently sourced from the FY2014 report's 'Financial Summary' table): the FY2015 report's Dec-31-2014 comparative column matches quarterly/2014_Q4.json exactly on every field checked (Total Assets 126,758.38 vs 126758, PAT 747.21 vs 747, Total Equity 11,698.50 vs 11698, EPS 1.02 vs 1.02, NAV/share 15.92 vs 15.92) -- two independently-sourced documents agreeing confirms this comparative-column data is reliable despite being single-sourced for the interim quarters themselves.
